MIT.reason: OSI/FSF free; grants use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, sell without fee; condition: keep copyright and permission notice.

MIT-CMU.reason: OSI-approved; permits use, copy, modify, distribute for any purpose without fee; condition: keep notice, no use of author names in advertising.

MIT-Modern-Variant.reason: OSI-approved MIT variant; same grants as MIT, notice must be kept.

X11.reason: FSF free MIT variant; same grants as MIT plus no use of the X Consortium name in advertising.

ISC.reason: OSI/FSF free; permits use, copy, modify, distribute for any purpose with or without fee; condition: keep notice.

0BSD.reason: OSI-approved; permits use, copy, modify, distribute for any purpose with or without fee, without conditions.

BSD-2-Clause.reason: OSI/FSF free; redistribution and use in source and binary form, with or without modification; condition: keep notice in source and in documentation of binaries.

BSD-3-Clause.reason: OSI/FSF free; as BSD-2-Clause plus no endorsement by contributor names.

Zlib.reason: OSI/FSF free; anyone may use for any purpose, including commercial, alter and redistribute; conditions: no misrepresentation, mark altered versions, keep notice in source.

bzip2-1.0.6.reason: BSD-style free license; redistribution and use with or without modification; conditions: keep notice, mark altered versions, no endorsement.

Libpng-2.0.reason: OSI-approved zlib-style license; use, copy, modify, distribute for any purpose without fee; conditions: no misrepresentation, mark altered versions.

libtiff.reason: FSF free permissive license; use, copy, modify, distribute, sell for any purpose without fee; condition: keep notices, no use of author names in advertising.

IJG.reason: FSF free; anyone may use, copy, modify, distribute for any purpose without fee; condition: binary-only distributions state that they are based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group (the NOTICE text carries that statement).

FTL.reason: FSF free (FreeType chosen from FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later); use, modify, redistribute commercially and non-commercially without fee; condition: credit The FreeType Project in documentation (the NOTICE text does this).

TCL.reason: FSF free; use, copy, modify, distribute, license for any purpose without fee; condition: keep notices.

PSF-2.0.reason: OSI-approved; nonexclusive, royalty-free, world-wide license to reproduce, prepare derivative works, distribute and otherwise use; condition: keep notice and summarize changes.

Apache-2.0.reason: OSI/FSF free; perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free copyright and patent license to reproduce, prepare derivative works, distribute; conditions: keep license, NOTICE files and attribution, state changes.

MPL-2.0.reason: OSI/FSF free, file-level copyleft; royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, distribute; condition: modified MPL files stay MPL with source available. Only certifi's unmodified CA bundle is used.

LGPL-3.0-or-later.reason: OSI/FSF free, weak copyleft; permits redistribution and modification commercially without fee; conditions: library source (and relinking ability) stays available, modifications to the library stay LGPL. psycopg2 adds an OpenSSL linking exception. Used as an unmodified, dynamically imported library.

AGPL-3.0-only.reason: OSI/FSF free, strong copyleft; permits copying, modification and distribution commercially and non-commercially without fee; conditions: works based on it are AGPL-3.0 and their complete source must be offered, including to users interacting over a network (§ 13). The service source is published anyway; the repository's own code stays MIT, which is AGPL-compatible.

GPL-3.0-only.reason: OSI/FSF free, strong copyleft; permits copying, modification and distribution commercially and non-commercially without fee; conditions: works based on it are GPL-3.0 with complete corresponding source offered on distribution. The sealy 0.3.0 wheel ships this text for its own code.

LicenseRef-Public-Domain.reason: Dedicated to the public domain by its authors: free to copy, modify, publish, use, compile, sell, distribute for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial, without conditions.

PostgreSQL.reason: OSI-approved; permission to use, copy, modify, distribute for any purpose without fee; condition: keep notice.

OLDAP-2.8.reason: OSI-approved BSD-style; redistribution and use with or without modification; conditions: keep notices, no use of OpenLDAP names/trademarks for endorsement.

BSD-Attribution-HPND-disclaimer.reason: FSF free BSD-style (Cyrus SASL); redistribution and use with or without modification; condition: every redistribution retains the CMU acknowledgment sentence (carried in the NOTICE text).

RSA-MD.reason: Free permissive (RSA MD5 reference code); copy and use without fee; condition: material referencing it identifies it as derived from the RSA Data Security MD5 algorithm (carried in the NOTICE text).

libselinux-1.0.reason: Public-domain dedication by the NSA; no restrictions on use, modification or redistribution.

LGPL-2.0-or-later.reason: OSI/FSF free, weak copyleft; redistribution and modification commercially without fee; conditions: library source stays available and relinking possible. Shipped unmodified as a separate shared object.

LGPL-2.1-or-later.reason: OSI/FSF free, weak copyleft; redistribution and modification commercially without fee; conditions: library source stays available and relinking possible. Shipped unmodified as a separate shared object.

LicenseRef-MIT-Kerberos.reason: MIT krb5 NOTICE: main terms BSD-2-Clause-style, redistribution and modification commercially without fee; sub-notices add attribution and US export notices and restrict use of MIT trademarks only. Its 4-clause advertising notices cover code (libdb2 KDB plugin, ksu, fallback strptime) not built into the client libraries shipped here.

LLVM-exception.reason: Exception to Apache-2.0 for LLVM runtimes: drops the Apache notice/attribution conditions for portions embedded in compiled object form; only broadens Apache-2.0 permissions.

Unicode-3.0.reason: OSI-approved; permission free of charge to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute and/or sell; condition: keep copyright and permission notice.

LicenseRef-Lucent-Rune.reason: Lucent notice on re2 util/rune.cc: permission to use, copy, modify, distribute for any purpose without fee; condition: keep notice.

LicenseRef-LimeZu-Modern-Interiors.reason: Not an open license: allows editing and commercial/non-commercial use as part of a project, but forbids distributing or reselling the assets to others; credit required.
LicenseRef-LimeZu-Modern-Interiors.exempt: art assets, not source code created for the service (§ 7 Abs. 1); inclusion and redistribution via this repository rest on LimeZu's permission recorded in assets/PERMISSION.md (§ 7 Abs. 3).
